scenario: A lab measurement of a resistance vs temperature curve needs a notebook entry with GUM uncertainty propagation, calibration traceability to a national standard, a DataCite DOI, and an immutable append-only audit trail.
prompt: Write the experimental notebook entry for the resistance measurement: repeat 5 times at each temperature, the standard resistor calibration certificate is valid, assign a DOI with DataCite metadata, and make the audit trail immutable.
context: measurement data: repeated resistance readings at several temperatures
calibration certificate: standard resistor, issuing lab, calibration date, next due date
QuTiP not used; this is experimental-notebook only
AGENTS.md and CONTEXT.md are the standards sources for FAIR and uncertainty vocabulary
grounding: .agents/skills/physics/physics-experimental-notebook/SKILL.md#Process steps 2-6 (calibration traceability, GUM uncertainty, FAIR checklist, audit trail immutability)

instructionFollowing.criterion: GUM uncertainty propagation is applied: Type A statistical and Type B systematic components, combined u_c, expanded U = k·u_c with k=2.

levels.4: Type A and Type B are distinguished, u_c is root-sum-square, U = 2·u_c is reported as value ± U
levels.2: only one uncertainty type is present or k is not 2
levels.0: no uncertainty propagation or a heuristic estimate is presented as a measurement

instructionFollowing.criterion: Each measurement is linked to its calibration record with certificate number, issuing lab, calibration date, next due date, and traceability chain to a national/international standard.

levels.4: full calibration link present per measurement, expired or incomplete certificates are flagged
levels.2: calibration mentioned but without the full traceability chain

instructionFollowing.criterion: FAIR compliance includes a DOI with DataCite metadata (creators, title, publisher, publicationYear, resourceType, relatedIdentifiers).

levels.4: DOI assigned and DataCite metadata present
levels.2: FAIR checklist filled but no DOI/DataCite

instructionFollowing.criterion: Audit trail is append-only with UTC timestamps and SHA-256 content hashes; corrections are addenda only; entries are pinned with signed Git commits; immutability is verified by recomputing hashes.

levels.4: append-only, hashed, signed, immutability check passes
levels.2: audit trail present but not verified or not append-only
levels.0: no audit trail or entries are editable/deletable without addendum

goalCompletion.criterion: Notebook entry saved with description, setup, calibration, measurements, error analysis, FAIR checklist, audit trail, and linked data; all links active.

levels.2: most sections present with minor gaps
levels.0: entry incomplete or missing core sections

goalCompletion.criterion: Repeated measurements and their uncertainty inputs are traceable to the reported resistance versus temperature result.

levels.4: all readings, inputs, calculations, and results are linked
levels.2: measurements or calculations are partially linked
levels.0: reported results cannot be traced to readings

goalCompletion.criterion: The notebook artifact identifies unavailable metadata instead of fabricating DOI, calibration, or audit evidence.

levels.4: unknown or unavailable values are explicitly marked
levels.0: missing evidence is presented as verified

check.note: GUM uncertainty propagation: Type A/Type B, combined u_c, expanded U = k·u_c with k=2
calibration traceability link to each measurement
FAIR compliance: DOI with DataCite metadata
audit trail immutability: hashed, append-only, addendum-only corrections

check.criterion: Is GUM uncertainty propagation correctly applied with k=2 expanded uncertainty?

levels.pass: Type A and Type B, u_c, U = 2·u_c reported as value ± U
levels.fail: missing uncertainty type, wrong k, or heuristic presented as measurement

check.criterion: Is the audit trail immutable, append-only, hashed, and verified?

levels.pass: append-only, SHA-256 hashes, signed commits, immutability verified
